title: The imperfect: what used to be
summary: Habits, descriptions and background in the past: hablaba, comía, vivía; era, iba, veía.
focus: Forms and uses of the imperfect (pretérito imperfecto)
content:
## What the imperfect is for

The **pretérito imperfecto** describes the past as it *used to be* or *was going on*, without saying when it started or ended. Use it for:

- **Habits and repeated actions**: *Antes vivíamos en un pueblo.* (We used to live in a village.) *Siempre comía en casa.* (I always ate at home.)
- **Descriptions** of people, places and things: *Mi abuela era muy simpática.* (My grandmother was very kind.)
- **Background** to a story: *Hacía frío y no había nadie en la calle.* (It was cold and there was nobody in the street.)

Typical markers: **antes**, **siempre**, **todos los días**, **cada verano**, **de pequeño / de pequeña** (as a child), **cuando era joven**.

## The endings: -aba and -ía

Remove the infinitive ending and add:

| person | -ar (hablar) | -er (comer) | -ir (vivir) |
|---|---|---|---|
| yo | habl**aba** | com**ía** | viv**ía** |
| tú | habl**abas** | com**ías** | viv**ías** |
| él / ella / usted | habl**aba** | com**ía** | viv**ía** |
| nosotros/as | habl**ábamos** | com**íamos** | viv**íamos** |
| vosotros/as | habl**abais** | com**íais** | viv**íais** |
| ellos / ellas / ustedes | habl**aban** | com**ían** | viv**ían** |

Three things to notice:

- **-er** and **-ir** verbs share the **-ía** endings, and every **-ía** form carries an accent.
- The **yo** and **él/ella** forms are identical: *yo hablaba, ella hablaba*.
- The only accent in **-aba** is on **nosotros**: *hablábamos*.

## Only three irregulars

Every other verb is regular in the imperfect, including *tener*, *hacer* and *estar* (*tenía*, *hacía*, *estaba*). Learn these three:

| person | ser | ir | ver |
|---|---|---|---|
| yo | **era** | **iba** | **veía** |
| tú | eras | ibas | veías |
| él / ella / usted | era | iba | veía |
| nosotros/as | éramos | íbamos | veíamos |
| vosotros/as | erais | ibais | veíais |
| ellos / ellas / ustedes | eran | iban | veían |

- *De pequeño iba al colegio a pie.* (As a child I walked to school.)
- *Veía dibujos animados todos los sábados.* (I watched cartoons every Saturday.)

## Age, time and weather in the past

Age, clock time, weather and *there was/were* are all background, so they take the imperfect:

- **Age**: *Tenía diez años.* (I was ten.)
- **Time**: *Eran las tres de la tarde.* (It was three in the afternoon.) *Era la una.* (It was one o'clock.)
- **Weather**: *Hacía mucho frío y llovía.* (It was very cold and it was raining.)
- **Había**: *Había un parque cerca de casa.* (There was a park near home.) *Había* is both singular and plural.

quiz.prompt: De pequeño yo ___ (vivir) en un pueblo y jugaba en la calle.
quiz.explanation: -ir verbs take -ía in the imperfect: 'vivía'. 'De pequeño' (as a child) signals a habit or description in the past.
Vosotros takes -íais in the imperfect: 'comíais'. 'Comisteis' is the preterite (one occasion), 'coméis' is present.
Ser is irregular in the imperfect: era, eras, era, éramos, erais, eran. A description of people takes the imperfect.

quiz.prompt: Cada verano nosotros ___ a la playa.
quiz.explanation: 'Cada verano' describes a repeated habit, so the imperfect of ir: 'íbamos', with an accent on the í.

quiz.prompt: De pequeña yo ___ (ver) dibujos animados todos los sábados.
quiz.explanation: Ver keeps its e in the imperfect: veía, veías, veía… It is one of the three irregulars.
hints: Ver is irregular here: it keeps the e of its stem before the ending.

quiz.explanation: Clock time in the past takes the imperfect of ser, plural for any hour except one: 'Eran las tres'.

quiz.prompt: Cuando tenía diez años, yo ___ (ir) al colegio a pie.
quiz.explanation: Ir in the imperfect: iba, ibas, iba, íbamos, ibais, iban. Age ('tenía diez años') also takes the imperfect.
hints: Ir is one of the three irregular imperfects.
Yo and él/ella share the same form.

quiz.prompt: Cuando vivíamos en el pueblo, en invierno ___ mucho frío.
quiz.explanation: Weather as background to a habitual past takes the imperfect: 'hacía frío'. Hacer is regular in the imperfect.

quiz.prompt: Cerca de mi casa ___ (haber) un parque muy grande.
quiz.explanation: 'There was / there were' in the imperfect is 'había', the same form for singular and plural.
hints: The imperfect of haber: the past of 'there is'.
One form for singular and plural.

listening.meaning: As a child I lived in Seville.

listening.text: Los sábados veíamos dibujos animados en casa.
listening.meaning: On Saturdays we watched cartoons at home.

listening.text: En mi calle había un cine muy pequeño.
listening.meaning: In my street there was a very small cinema.

listening.text: Cada verano íbamos al pueblo de mi padre.
listening.meaning: Every summer we went to my father's village.
listening.note: The nosotros form of ir carries an accent: íbamos.

listening.text: Cuando era pequeño, iba al colegio en autobús.
listening.meaning: When I was little, I went to school by bus.

listening.text: Antes había un jardín detrás de la casa.
listening.meaning: There used to be a garden behind the house.
listening.note: New word: el jardín = the garden.

listening.text: Mis vecinos tenían un gato blanco y negro.
listening.meaning: My neighbours had a black and white cat.
listening.note: New word: el gato = the cat.

listening.text: De pequeño mi hermano siempre llevaba gafas y era muy tímido.
listening.meaning: As a child my brother always wore glasses and was very shy.

guide.tip: Two sounds to remember: -aba for -ar verbs, -ía for everything else. Yo and él/ella take the same form: yo hablaba, ella hablaba.

conversations.title: When grandma was little
conversations.scenario: Nico asks his grandmother Rosa what her life was like when she was a child in the village.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Abuela, ¿cómo era tu vida de pequeña?
lines.meaning: Grandma, what was your life like as a child?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Muy diferente. Vivíamos en un pueblo pequeño y no había coches en la calle.
lines.meaning: Very different. We lived in a small village and there were no cars in the street.

lines.speaker: a
lines.meaning: And how did you get to school?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Iba a pie, con mis hermanos. El colegio estaba lejos y en invierno hacía mucho frío.
lines.meaning: I walked, with my brothers. The school was far away and in winter it was very cold.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: No, no teníamos. Por la tarde jugábamos en la calle y los domingos veíamos una película en el cine del pueblo.
lines.meaning: No, we didn't. In the afternoon we played in the street and on Sundays we watched a film at the village cinema.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Comíamos lo que había en el huerto: patatas, tomates… Mi madre cocinaba muy bien.
lines.meaning: We ate what there was in the vegetable garden: potatoes, tomatoes… My mother cooked very well.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Sí, mucho. Los vecinos eran como una familia y siempre había alguien con quien hablar.
lines.meaning: Yes, very. The neighbours were like a family and there was always someone to talk to.

bites.title: Used to, was -ing
bites.rule: The imperfect is for habits, descriptions and background in the past: what used to happen or was going on. Markers: antes, siempre, de pequeño, cada verano.
bites.example_meaning: We used to live in a village.

bites.title: -aba and -ía
bites.example_meaning: I was talking and she was eating.

bites.title: Only three irregulars
bites.rule: Ser → era, ir → iba, ver → veía. Everything else is regular, even tener (tenía), hacer (hacía) and estar (estaba).
bites.example: De pequeño iba al colegio a pie.
bites.example_meaning: As a child I walked to school.

bites.title: Age, time, weather
bites.rule: Background facts take the imperfect: tenía diez años, eran las tres, hacía frío, había un parque.
bites.example: Eran las tres y hacía frío.
bites.example_meaning: It was three o'clock and it was cold.

sorts.title: Imperfect or preterite?
sorts.why: -aba and -ía endings (and era, iba) are imperfect; -í, -ó and fui/fue are preterite.

sorts.title: Regular or irregular in the imperfect?
sorts.why: Only ser, ir and ver are irregular. Tener, hacer and estar follow the normal pattern (tenía, hacía, estaba).

spots.sentence: De pequeño yo vivaba en un pueblo.
Cuando yo era pequeño, mi abuela es muy simpática.
spots.why: A description in the past takes the imperfect of ser: era.

spots.sentence: Cada verano ibamos a la playa.
spots.why: The nosotros form of ir carries an accent: íbamos.

spots.sentence: Antes nosotros hablabamos mucho por teléfono.
spots.why: The only accented -aba form is nosotros: hablábamos.

spots.sentence: De pequeña veí dibujos animados todos los sábados.
spots.why: 'Todos los sábados' is a habit, so the imperfect: veía.

spots.sentence: Era las tres de la tarde cuando llegó.
spots.why: Hours other than one o'clock are plural: eran las tres.
